description: One labelled batch of reviews across 12 providers over 60 days, scored together the way the admin 'Scan reviews' button scores the whole table. 'day' is days after the start of the window, 'accountAgeDays' is how old the customer account was when the review was written, 'completedBooking' is whether that customer has a completed booking with that provider. Labels come from the scenario each review was written to represent, assigned before the detector was run.
